common.disclaimer: Steady does not diagnose any condition. It is not a substitute for medical advice.

quality.no_hand: Place your hand in the frame.
quality.no_face: Place your face in the frame.
quality.too_bright: Reduce glare or move away from the light.
quality.too_close: Move the phone a little farther away.
quality.too_far: Move the phone a little closer.
quality.out_of_frame: Move back so everything stays in the frame.
